description: 국토교통부_일반버스·도시철도이용O/D [railways and stations and bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 일반버스 및 도시철도 O/D 일간 데이터는 특정 일자에 대중교통(일반버스 및 도시철도)을 이용한 승객들의 출발지(Origin)와 도착지(Destination) 정보를 체계적으로 기록한. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 일일일반버스도시철도OD, OD이용데이터, 승객이동경로, 출발도착이용패턴, 교통이용OD분석. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
